name: seoscrape
description: Internal product content & SEO checker for owned webshop domains

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/worker
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('\n> Full Node backend: run \\'npx playwright install chromium\\' once for Playwright rendering. Cloudflare Worker mode does not need Chromium.\n')"
